headword: {明|あ}けましておめでとうございます
reading: あけましておめでとうございます

definitions.gloss: Happy New Year (said from January 1 onward)
definitions.explanation: The New Year greeting, said on meeting someone for the first time in the new year and written at the top of New Year's cards; literally 'congratulations on the (year) having opened.' It is used from January 1, never before, and is normally followed by {今年|ことし}もよろしくお{願|ねが}いします.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}けましておめでとうございます。⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしくお{願|ねが}いします→よろしくお願いします：23566_yoroshikuonegaishimasu⟧。
examples.english: Happy New Year. I look forward to another good year with you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{明|あ}けましておめでとうございます」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote 'Happy New Year' on the New Year's cards.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧になって⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、「{明|あ}けましておめでとうございます」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: When I met my colleagues for the first time in January, we exchanged New Year's greetings.

notes:
USAGE:
- Said from January 1 until about the middle of January, once to each person, at the first meeting of the year
- Before the year ends, the parting greeting is ⟦{良|よ}いお{年|とし}を→良いお年を：30852_yoiotoshiwo⟧
- Not used to a family in mourning, who send notice that they will skip the New Year greetings

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {明|あ}けましておめでとうございます。⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしくお{願|ねが}いします→よろしくお願いします：23566_yoroshikuonegaishimasu⟧: the full formula
- ⟦{明|あ}けまして→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧: casual, among friends and family
- あけおめ: slang abbreviation in text messages, often with ことよろ for the second half

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{良|よ}いお{年|とし}を→良いお年を：30852_yoiotoshiwo⟧: have a good New Year (before the year ends)
- ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧: New Year's
- ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧: New Year's card
